what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Pig Catcher
summary: Real annular tyres and open spoke interiors at every LOD replace opaque wheel caps. The rider has a tapered LOD0 torso, neck clearance, narrower leg stance, lower and better placed elbows, and a helmet peak even at the smallest tier. A retained beak transition avoids a single unbroken plank. Engine reduction was rejected after broad-form comparison; the enclosing engine volume is retained. Original collision inputs are frozen in colliders.json. Exported intact triangles: 2514 / 898 / 596 against 2800 / 900 / 600. Front/rear whole-view silhouettes improve at every tier. LOD0/1 weighted scores improve; LOD2 weighted score regresses by 0.0049, with side/top losses. The bike remains visibly approximate: plastics, engine and low-tier limbs are blockier than the sheet, and the rack/rope/sack differ in detail. It does not meet the general ~0.95 reference-parity target. Open spokes are a real geometry improvement that filled silhouette IoU cannot measure.
